name: OpenBrowser
description: Manage isolated Chromium browser profiles with proxy support, window synchronization, and local RPA automation.

paragraphs: OpenBrowser is a tool for managing multiple online profiles on your Windows computer. Each profile works as a separate browser environment. This keeps your activity, cookies, and login sessions isolated from one another. You can assign unique proxies to every profile and manage digital fingerprints to keep your identity secure. It also supports task automation to save you time.
features: OpenBrowser helps you manage complex web tasks through a simple interface.
Each profile behaves like a distinct computer. Websites cannot see data from your other profiles. This prevents tracking and keeps your personal and work accounts separate.
